newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria First Bank to raise 2.1 bln naira.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria First Bank to raise 2.1 bln naira.

text.p: First Bank, the oldest bank in Nigeria, is to raise 2.1 billion naira through a new share issue, the stock exchange said on Tuesday.
The exchange told dealers the bank would issue 200 million shares at 10.50 naira each by public offer. The date of the issue was not announced.
Because of the new issue shares in First Bank were put on technical suspension on Tuesday at 12.60 naira.
First Bank spokesman Toyin Abayomi-Banjo said part of the money raised by the share issue would be used for improving services, including further computerisation of branches.
"We intend to position ourselves for the next century," he said. "We need to restructure and we will be investing in technology."
Last year, Britain's Standard Chartered Bank divested its 9.9 percent holding in First Bank, which began operations in 1894 and has over 300 branches across Nigeria.
